description: Textos de la interfaz del hangar y del control por gestos, con su traducción al inglés. `armar.py` los añade al diccionario `src/i18n/en.json`.

exact.Conduce con gestos de la mano ante la cá: Drive with hand gestures in front of the camera. The image never leaves your device.
exact.No veo tu mano: el robot espera: I can't see your hand: the robot waits
exact.Inclínala: gira, como un volante: Tilt it: steer, like a steering wheel
exact.Conduces con la mano: ábrela para avanza: You are driving by hand: open it to go forward, tilt it to steer and close it to brake. The keyboard still works.
exact.Con la mano: el botón «Con la mano» enci: By hand: the «Hand control» button turns on the camera. Open hand, forward; tilted, it steers like a wheel; two fingers, reverse; fist, brake. If the camera stops seeing your hand, the robot stops. The image is analyzed on your device: it is not recorded or sent.
exact.Imagen de tu cámara, como en un espejo: Your camera image, like a mirror
exact.La imagen se analiza en tu equipo: no se: The image is analyzed on your device: it is not recorded or sent.
exact.Falta el permiso de la cámara. Pulsa el: Camera permission is missing. Click the padlock in the address bar, allow the camera and turn it on again.
exact.Otra aplicación está usando la cámara. C: Another app is using the camera. Close it and try again.
The camera does not support the requested image.
exact.La cámara solo funciona en una dirección: The camera only works on a secure address (https) or on localhost.
exact.No se pudo encender la cámara o cargar e: The camera could not be turned on or the hand detector could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
exact.Muestra una mano a la cámara: Show a hand to the camera
exact.Dos manos: sepáralas o júntalas: Two hands: spread them or bring them together
exact.Cada robot, pieza a pieza: qué lleva, en: Each robot, piece by piece: what it carries, which missions it flew on and how it did in your tests.
exact.No se pudo cargar el modelo 3D. Revisa l: The 3D model could not be loaded. Check your connection and pick the robot again.
exact.No hay un modelo 3D publicado de este ro: There is no published 3D model of this robot, nor measurements to draw it, so its shape is not made up here.
exact.Su ficha y su historial sí están: míralo: Its data sheet and history are here: see them on the right.
exact.Una mano abierta: muévela para girarlo: One open hand: move it to rotate the robot
exact.Dos manos: sepáralas para desarmarlo y j: Two hands: spread them to take it apart, bring them together to assemble it
exact.Señala un momento: siguiente componente: Point for a moment: next component
exact.Mueve el holograma con las manos ante la: Move the hologram with your hands in front of the camera. The image never leaves your device.
exact.Arrastra para girar, usa la rueda para a: Drag to rotate, use the wheel to zoom and click a piece.
exact.Qué ver del robot: What to see about the robot
Pick a piece, here or on the hologram. «Flight heritage» means the other missions on which that same piece or its design flew, or will fly.
exact.Otras misiones con esta misma pieza o di: Other missions with this same piece or design
exact.Sin historial comprobado para este robot: No verified history for this robot.
exact.Todavía no has probado este robot en el: You have not tested this robot in the simulator yet.
exact.Probar este robot en el simulador: Test this robot in the simulator
exact.Elige un lugar en el Mundo y abre «Prueb: Pick a place in the World and open «Robot test»: the simulator will start with this robot. Your tests are saved in this browser and are simulator results, not field tests.
exact.Datos de NASA, JPL, NSSDC, ESA y el Smit: Data from NASA, JPL, NSSDC, ESA and the Smithsonian, checked on
exact.En este modelo 3D esta pieza no viene se: In this 3D model this piece is not separate from the rest: it is not highlighted on its own.
exact.No encontramos una fuente que confirme e: We found no source confirming this piece on another mission.
exact.Ver sus piezas en holograma ↗: See its parts as a hologram ↗
exact.Abre el hangar en otra pestaña: el robot: Opens the hangar in another tab: the robot taken apart piece by piece, with its data and missions
exact.Elegir otro robot del catálogo: Choose another robot from the catalog
